# Task M-05c: optional Last.fm (and AcoustID) keys in Settings; Last.fm facts for the song page

**Phase:** maintenance · **Depends on:** M-05a (merged) · **Suggested tier:** Sonnet subagent · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal

Owner request (2026-10-10): Last.fm is an optional configuration item; when a key exists, the song page shows what Last.fm knows about the song. Today Wondarr has no global Last.fm key (only a per-import-list `apiKey`), and the AcoustID client key can only be set in `config.yml` or the environment — no screen shows either.

## Deliverables

1. **Configuration:** `lastfm.api_key` (new `LastFmOptions`, env `APP__LASTFM__API_KEY`), beside the existing `acoustid.client_key`. Document both in `website/src/content/docs/reference/configuration.md`.
2. **`GET`/`PUT /api/v1/metadata/settings`**, following the Soulseek/YouTube settings controllers' pattern (written through `ConfigFileWriter`, applied live through `IOptionsMonitor`): `{ acoustIdKeySet, acoustIdLocked, lastFmKeySet, lastFmLocked }` on GET — **keys are never returned**; PUT takes `acoustIdClientKey?` / `lastFmApiKey?` (absent = unchanged, empty string = remove). A field set by an environment variable is locked and a change to it is refused with the same message the other settings pages use. **Test** buttons: `POST /api/v1/metadata/settings/test` with `{ service: "lastfm" | "acoustid", key? }` (the typed key, or the stored one) → `{ ok, message }` (Last.fm: one `track.getInfo` call; AcoustID: one lookup call that only checks the key is accepted).
3. **Settings → General** gets a **Metadata services** card: AcoustID client key and Last.fm API key, each a password field showing "Stored — type to replace" when set, a Test button, a link to where to get a key (`https://acoustid.org/new-application`, `https://www.last.fm/api/account/create`), and one line on what each is used for (AcoustID: fingerprint verification of downloads and identifying reference files; Last.fm: facts on the song page, and the default key for Last.fm import lists).
4. **Last.fm client** (`src/Wondarr.Core/Metadata/LastFm/`, reusing the named `HttpClient` already registered for Last.fm import lists): `track.getInfo` (mbid when the song has one, else artist + track, `autocorrect=1`), `artist.getInfo`, `track.getSimilar` (limit 10). Keep under 5 requests per second (a shared limiter like the other metadata clients), honour `Retry-After` and Last.fm's error code 29 (rate limit) with a back-off; cache each response in memory for 24 h; a 5 s timeout.
5. **`GET /api/v1/song/{id}/details`** (from M-05a) gains `lastFm` when a key is set, else `null`: `url`, `listeners`, `playcount`, `tags` (top 5 names), `wiki` (the summary as plain text — strip Last.fm's HTML and its trailing "Read more on Last.fm" anchor; keep the `url` for attribution), `artist` (`name`, `url`, `bioSummary` plain text, `listeners`), `similar` (up to 10: `artist`, `title`, `url`, `match`, and the Wondarr song id when that recording is already in the library — match by MBID, else by normalised artist + title). A failure leaves `lastFm` null and the endpoint answers 200.
6. **Import lists:** a Last.fm import list with no `apiKey` of its own uses `lastfm.api_key` (its form says so in the help text); with neither, it reports the existing "needs an API key" error.
7. Regenerate `docs/api/openapi.json` and `frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts`; hooks in `frontend/src/api/` (`useMetadataSettings`, `useUpdateMetadataSettings`, `useTestMetadataKey`). Docs: `website/.../getting-started/first-run.md` or `reference/configuration.md` — where to set the keys. `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` → `### Added`.

## Allowed paths

- `src/Wondarr.Core/Metadata/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Configuration/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/ImportLists/LastFm/**`, `src/Wondarr.Core/Songs/**`
- `src/Wondarr.Api/Metadata/**` (new), `src/Wondarr.Api/Songs/**`, `src/Wondarr.Api/Program.cs` (registration only, if needed)
- `tests/Wondarr.Core.Tests/**`, `tests/Wondarr.Api.Tests/**`
- `docs/api/openapi.json`, `frontend/src/api/**`, `frontend/src/pages/settings/GeneralSettingsPage.tsx` (+ test), `frontend/src/test/fixtures.ts`
- `website/src/content/docs/reference/configuration.md`, `website/src/content/docs/getting-started/first-run.md`, `website/src/content/docs/library/import-lists.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`

## Constraints

- No key in any response, log line or exception message. AGENTS.md external limits (honour `Retry-After`).
- The song page's Last.fm block itself is M-05b's (add it to the page there); this task only provides the data and the settings card.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `dotnet build -warnaserror`; `dotnet test` Core then Api (one at a time); `cd frontend && npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build`; `cd website && npm ci && npm run build` — green.
2. Tests: settings GET never contains a key; PUT set/unchanged/remove; env-locked refusal; the test endpoint with a stubbed Last.fm (ok, invalid key error 10, rate limit 29); the client's cache (one call for two lookups) and back-off on 29; `/details` with a key (fields mapped, HTML stripped, similar track matched to a library song) and without (null, no call); an import list without its own key uses the global one; the General page card shows "Stored — type to replace" and calls the test endpoint.
